blocks.content: Basically, a Suspense boundary is any <Suspense> component in the tree that catches lazy children while their chunks load.
When a component suspends, React walks up and uses the nearest boundary it finds.
That means we can place Suspense boundaries at any level of the tree — one per route, one per section, or one at the top.
Let's compare the two most common approaches.
